comment: The one list of entity-reference fields (spec/world.md "Identity"), generated by generate-entity-refs.mjs from world.schema.json's x-entity-ref markers — never hand-edited. kind: "bindable" = a name is accepted at intake and MUST bind to an id at ingestion; "id" = numeric only. scope: the object the path walks from — an entity (or its patch, the same fields), the manifest's avatar, or one creation in creations[]. "*" walks every array element.
